title: High-Dimensional Deterministic Secure Quantum Communication with Reed-Solomon Erasure Coding
authors: L. F. A. de Sousa Moura
summary: Deterministic Secure Quantum Communication (DSQC) is a quantum cryptographic technique engineered to transfer a message through a quantum channel, requiring an auxiliary classical channel for eavesdropping verification and decoding, but without prior key distribution. This article presents a theoretical high-dimensional prepare and measure DSQC protocol using the Reed-Solomon erasure coding to ensure data resilience to noise.
